info.name: cclu-api
info.description: Manual testing collection for the CCLU API. Every endpoint lives in the folder of the module that owns it. Values are never stored here: import postman.environment.example.json as a Postman environment and fill it in locally.

item.name: Health
item.description: Service and database reachability. Not part of the domain.

request.description: Returns 200 with "database": "connected" when the API reached MongoDB, and 503 with "database": "disconnected" when the process started but the connection is down.
